Klamath and Salmon River War of 1855 and its aftermath · 14 links

A regional historical topic linked here for Karuk, Yurok, and Hupa context. The Klamath River is a place name here; this is not a study of the Klamath people of Oregon. Relevance must be assessed source by source.
